item.title: Toward Complete Characterization of Topological Insulators and Superconductors: A Systematic Construction of Topological Invariants Based on Atiyah-Hirzebruch Spectral Sequence
item.description:
A framework based on the Atiyah-Hirzebruch spectral sequence in momentum space yields topological invariants that classify stable superconducting phases across 159 space groups. [Phys. Rev. X 16, 041024] Published Fri Oct 23, 2026

Seishiro Ono, Ken Shiozaki
